newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sumitomo Corp has no comment on SIB report.
newsitem.headline: Sumitomo Corp has no comment on SIB report.

text.p: Sumitomo Corp said on Friday it had no comment on a report by a U.K. financial watchdog recommending that the London Metal Exchange (LME) provide more information and tighten some of its regulations.
"We're not prepared to give any official statement on that," a Sumitomo spokesman said.

Britain's Securities and Investments Board (SIB) issued its report on Thursday, following a review requested by the LME after Sumitomo's announcement in June of multi-billion dollar losses from allegedly unauthorised copper trades.
Traders at other Japanese trade houses said they doubted the changes urged by the SIB would affect their activity on the LME.
"A drastic shift to another metal market like New York is unlikely at the moment," one copper trader said.
